modalLead: Config is fully keyboard-navigable now — section rail, sub-tabs, Pages & tags lists, and the bookmarks editor. Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+K finds any setting (also under Help in the left nav); Shift+S and the gear icon reopen where you left off; 0–9 leave config for Inbox or a bookmark page.

items.text: Keyboard navigation across config — the section rail follows the ARIA tabs pattern (j/k, arrow keys, g/G). Sub-tabs cycle with [/] or Alt + ←/→. Pages & tags lists move rows with ↑/↓; the bookmarks master list uses j/k, Enter, /, and g/G. Choice rows and sliders honour arrow keys and Home/End (dashboard-config.js, keyboard-navigation.js).

Settings jump — Ctrl/Cmd + Shift + K opens a filterable overlay to jump to any section, sub-tab, help topic, or field label you have visited (config-settings-jump). A Find settings entry below Help in the left nav opens the same overlay.

Keyboard discoverability — form sections show a footer legend; Help → Search & keyboard adds a Config navigation panel; the first config open shows a one-time intro toast (! for the full cheat sheet). Press Shift+K in a form legend to open settings jump.
Config remembers where you left off — reopening with Shift+S, <, the gear icon, or bare #config restores the last section and sub-tab in localStorage. Deep links like #config/appearance still win.
Page and Inbox shortcuts from config — 0–9 leave config for Inbox (0) or a bookmark page (1–9), same as on the dashboard grid, instead of jumping config sections.
Letter keys stay in config — bare letters no longer open shortcut search while config is active; the config keyboard router owns the layer until you leave (search.js, keyboard-navigation.js).

Header destination order — page tabs, then the pages overview button, then inbox, health, and config share one tight cluster with even spacing. Inbox no longer sits inside the tab strip (header-destinations, dashboard-page-nav.js).

Help, MANUAL, and Overview — Config → Help, MANUAL.md, README, and Config → Overview → Latest update describe the new shortcuts, return visits, and header destination order. Cheat sheet Config view group updated (0–9, no more 1–8 section digits).
Cache-bust — whats-new-v207 data version and 2026.07-dashboard-release-v149 dashboard release token; Playwright coverage for config keyboard, location memory, and discoverability.
